rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
F = qvB sinθ
ε = −N dΦ/dt
F = BIL

rows.text: Force on moving charge F = q(v×B); on a wire F = BIL sinθ.  ·  Faraday: EMF ε = −dΦ/dt; Lenz's law gives the sign (induced current opposes the change in flux).

rows.text: Trick 1: E°cell = E°cathode − E°anode (reduction potentials, no multiplication by stoichiometry) — the 'no multiplication' note is the classic 1-mark trap.  ·  Trick 2: Higher reduction potential = better oxidising agent = cathode; SHE is the zero reference — order species by E° to predict feasibility.
